choosePasswordBody: Hesabınız için bir parola belirlediğinizde e-postanız doğrulanır.
errorInvalidToken: Bu doğrulama bağlantısı geçersiz veya süresi dolmuş.
errorEmailTaken: Bu e-posta adresi artık başka bir hesap tarafından kullanılıyor, bu nedenle onaylanamaz.
errorVerificationDisabled: E-posta doğrulaması bu sunucuda etkin değil.
errorNotFound: Bu bağlantıya ait bir hesap bulamadık.
resendTitle: Yeni bir bağlantıya mı ihtiyacınız var?
resendBody: Kaydolurken kullandığınız adresi girin; hâlâ bekliyorsa yeni bir doğrulama e-postası göndeririz.
resendSent: Bu adres doğrulama bekliyorsa yeni bir e-posta yolda.
resendTooManyAttempts: Çok fazla deneme yapıldı. Lütfen tekrar denemeden önce bekleyin.
cancelBody: Someone asked to change the email address of your account, or changed it. If it wasn't you, report it: the change is cancelled or undone, your account is signed out everywhere and its API keys are revoked.
cancelledBody: The change was cancelled, your account was signed out everywhere and its API keys were revoked. Someone else may know your password, so sign in and change it now, or use the forgotten password link.
restoredBody: Your account uses its previous email address again, was signed out everywhere and its API keys were revoked. Someone else may know your password, so sign in and change it now, or use the forgotten password link.
notRestoredTitle: Your previous email address could not be restored
notRestoredBody: The change was reported, your account was signed out everywhere and its API keys were revoked. Another account uses your previous address now, so your account keeps the new one. Contact your Endurain administrator, and change your password.
cancelInvalidBody: The link is invalid, expired or already used, or the email address was changed again after it was sent. If you still think someone else has access, sign in and change your password.
cancelError: We couldn't cancel the change. Please try again.
